name: Neralus
description: Neralus was a gas giant in the Haileap system, part of a binary planet along with Nixus, which was also a gas giant. Both planets were orbited by the jungle moon Wevo. One of the two planets was brown and orange striped in appearance.
lead_paragraphs: Neralus was a gas giant in the Haileap system, part of a binary planet along with Nixus, which was also a gas giant. Both planets were orbited by the jungle moon Wevo. One of the two planets was brown and orange striped in appearance.
